Definition: Aner, a Amorite, also a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Aner = "boy"; n pr m; 1) one of the Amorite chiefs who aided Abraham in the pursuit of the 4 invading kings; n pr loc; 2) a Levitical city west of the Jordan in Manasseh allotted to the Kohathite Levites
